title: Delicate
description: Obtain delicate blocks with silk touch
body: # Delicate Some blocks you encounter in survival gameplay cannot be obtained even with silk touch. Well, I want those blocks, so I made this datapack. ![](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/LV39qub3/images/644c78de6f21db09990f806a127ff5865414bfcd.gif) ## We can now obtain | Block | | | --- | --- | | Budding amethyst | | | Chorus plant | | | Dirt path | | | Farmland | | | Frogspawn | | | Reinforced deepslate | |
